BETA Close X Bellway PLC has announced the purchase of 344,380 ordinary shares on the London Stock Exchange between June 8th and June 12th, 2026, as part of its ongoing share buyback program. The highest price paid per share was 1,801.00 GBp, and the lowest was 1,719.00 GBp, with a volume-weighted average price of 1,767.56 GBp. These shares will be cancelled, reducing the total number of ordinary shares in issue to 113,834,206. This buyback activity reflects the company's commitment to returning value to shareholders. Disclaimer* Bellway PLC 15 June 2026 Bellway p.l.c. Transaction in Own Shares 15 June 2026 Bellway p.l.c. ('Bellway' or the 'Group') announces that, in accordance with the terms of the share buyback programme (the 'Buyback Programme') announced on 14 October 2025 and the terms of the Second Tranche announced on 2 April 2026, from 8 June 2026 up to and including 12 June 2026 the Group purchased the following number of ordinary shares of 12.5 pence each (the Ordinary Shares') through Deutsche Bank AG. Date Number of shares purchased Highest price paid (GBp) Lowest price paid (GBp) Volume weighted average price (GBp) Trading venue 8 June 2026 70,500 1,796.00 1,748.00 1,769.77 XLON 9 June 2026 64,380 1,801.00 1,765.00 1,791.62 XLON 10 June 2026 70,000 1,797.00 1,755.00 1,776.52 XLON 11 June 2026 71,500 1,759.00 1,719.00 1,742.08 XLON 12 June 2026 68,000 1,794.00 1,743.00 1,760.07 XLON The purchased Ordinary Shares will be cancelled. Since the announcement of the Second Tranche of the Buyback Programme on 2 April 2026, Bellway has purchased 2,507,533 Ordinary Shares in aggregate for cancellation. Bellway has now purchased 5,465,849 Ordinary Shares under the first and second tranche (to date) in aggregate for cancellation under the Buyback Programme. Following settlement of the above purchases and cancellation of the purchased ordinary shares, the Group's total number of ordinary shares in issue shall be 113,834,206 ordinary shares. In accordance with Article 5(1)(b) of Regulation (EU) No 596/2014 as it applies in the UK (the Market Abuse Regulation), the table below contains detailed information of the individual trades made by Deutsche Bank AG on behalf of Bellway as part of the Buyback Programme.
